name: explain-slide-pptx
description: Editable 16:9 PowerPoint explain slides in the png-explain infographic style: navy border, bold title with one accent word, a 'What is X?' intro strip, 1 to 4 header-pill panels with definition, figure + credit, native PowerPoint equation box (LaTeX -> OMML via pandoc), symbol list, Key points and Example boxes. Text heights are measured so the layout flows and overflow is reported, plus a PowerPoint export for visual QA. Ships the explain-slides-maker agent. Skills: `explain-slide-pptx`.
